name: Multi-Expert Seizure Annotation (spontaneous + stimulation-induced SEEG seizures)
format: BIDS; annotations.tsv/.json at root; per-subject ses-postimplant + derivatives (electrode localisation)
labels: 3–5 epileptologists per seizure: onset time, onset channels, channels seizing at 10 s, consensus columns; stimulation channels, frequency, amplitude, pulse width
caveats: Patient overlap with other Penn CNT sets likely (HUP IDs)
checks: Pennsieve: participants.tsv (29 rows) and annotations.tsv (78 rows) read and tallied; tree walked.
pipeline: Ground truth for onset and early-spread agents, and the only open human set pairing stimulation parameters with the seizures they induced: a direct test of the VEC 'stimulated seizure' module.
key_claim: 78 SEEG seizures (34 stimulation-induced, with stim parameters) with multi-expert consensus onset and spread labels.

evidence.quote: We present stereotactic EEG recordings from 78 seizures (44 spontaneous, 34 stimulation-induced) across 29 patients
Three or five board-certified epileptologists independently annotated each seizure for onset time, onset channels, and channels seizing at 10 seconds post-onset
